hints.title: Dependency Ordering
hints.text: A course can only be taken once all its prerequisite courses are completed in earlier semesters.

hints.title: Indegree Waves
hints.text: Calculate in-degree for each course. Courses with in-degree zero can all be taken concurrently in the current semester.

hints.title: Cycle Detection and Wave Count
hints.text: Reduce in-degrees of dependent courses and advance wave by wave. If the count of taken courses equals n, return semester count; else return negative 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Depth-first search path tracking without topological level tracking requires complex cycle detection.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Kahn algorithm with in-degree tracking evaluates prerequisite layers and detects cycles in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that parallel course execution equals the diameter or depth of the DAG in topological waves.
complexity.notes: Returns -1 if a cycle prevents graduating from all courses.
